verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is delivered mainly through first-party APIs: the Agentic Cart API with session commit and cancel, the Agentic Feed API for batch product uploads, ACP/UCP checkout flows, published OpenAPI definitions, and an official MCP server. That shows strong programmatic access, but no evidence documents parity with any UI or says every UI action is exposed through the API. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a mapping of dashboard or Customer Area functions to API endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration of full parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
